# 1915 Group

> 1915 Group is an independent market-entry and strategic advisory firm for the jan san (janitorial/sanitation), Building Service Contractor (BSC), foodservice distribution, and industrial/MRO distribution sectors. Founded by Sean O'Hearn, who brings senior executive experience across manufacturing, distribution, and healthcare operations. The firm is unbiased and independent from manufacturers and distributors.

## Services

- Market entry diagnostics: a three-phase engagement (Diagnostic, Deep Dive, Implementation Planning) to evaluate whether and how a business should enter a new market, channel, or territory.
- SKU rationalization: identifying which products in a distributor's line to keep, cut, or reprice based on velocity, margin contribution, and strategic fit.
- Bill 72 (Ontario Buy Ontario Act) compliance: helping public sector buyers and their Building Service Contractors understand and close gaps in Canadian-content procurement compliance for cleaning consumables.
- Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) strategy: guidance for distributors and BSCs on GPO partnerships and channel economics.

## Industry Insights

- [Compliance for Canadian Public Sector Buyers](https://1915group.com/compliance-canadian-public-sector-buyers.html): What Ontario's Bill 72 requires, and the structural blind spot in cleaning consumables procurement most public buyers haven't checked yet.
